# uint8 is taken as the unsigned 8-bit type named in the task (values 0..255).

def parity(x: uint8) -> bool:
    """True when the byte has an odd number of set bits."""
    ex parity(0) == False
    ex parity(1) == True
    ex parity(7) == True
    ex parity(3) == False
    ones: uint8 = 0
    n = x
    while n > 0:
        ones += n & 1
        n = n >> 1
    return ones % 2 == 1
